packageRules.description: hk.pkl, mise.toml and the mise.*.toml overlays are Copier-managed (regenerated on every `copier update` from rust-tools' template). Let Copier own tool versions instead of Renovate bumping them directly, to avoid the two racing. Covers the built-in mise manager and hk-config's custom.regex manager.
semantic-pr.yml's hugoh/gh-workflows pin is Copier-owned: it is bumped in rust-tools' template and reaches consumers via `copier update`.
